by: Claude Code (opus), titles and abstracts only

question.population: Adults with Graves' orbitopathy (thyroid eye disease)
question.outcome: Eye disease activity, how the disease develops, and quality of life

decisions.reason: Meta-analysis of RCTs comparing selenium with placebo in Graves' orbitopathy patients, reporting clinical activity score and GO-QOL outcomes.

question.outcome: Thyroid hormones and dose of thyroid medicine, well-being, or thyroid antibodies

decisions.reason: Pooled randomised trials of selenium in Hashimoto's thyroiditis, reporting thyroid antibodies and thyroid hormones (TSH, FT3, FT4).
Meta-analysis of RCTs of selenium in Hashimoto's thyroiditis versus control, reporting thyroid hormones, antibodies and patient-reported outcomes.
Selenium in Hashimoto's thyroiditis with antibody outcomes, but it pooled 'controlled trials' that are not clearly all randomised.
Overview that re-pooled RCTs of selenium in autoimmune (Hashimoto's) thyroiditis, reporting thyroid antibody outcomes by LT4 status.
Pooled RCTs of selenium vs placebo, but in autoimmune thyroid disease generally, not only Hashimoto's thyroiditis.
Cochrane review of RCTs of selenium vs placebo in adults with Hashimoto's thyroiditis; pooled antibody data and reported well-being.
Adults with autoimmune thyroiditis given selenium vs placebo/LT4 with antibody outcomes, but it pooled controlled trials, not only RCTs.
Adults with autoimmune thyroiditis, selenium vs placebo, TSH and quality of life, but it pooled controlled trials, not only RCTs.
Meta-analysis of randomised placebo-controlled trials of selenium in Hashimoto's patients on LT4, reporting antibodies and mood/well-being.

question.population: Adults without diabetes at the start
question.outcome: New type 2 diabetes, or blood sugar

decisions.reason: Pooled RCTs of selenium vs placebo on fasting blood sugar, but the population is not limited to adults without diabetes.
Pooled selenium RCTs on glucose markers, but only in patients with cardiometabolic diseases, so this is treatment rather than prevention.
Pools only observational studies of selenium exposure, not randomised trials of supplements.
Selenium was always given together with probiotics, so its effect on blood sugar cannot be separated.
Selenium is one of the add-on supplements studied, but the population is people who already have type 2 diabetes.
Network meta-analysis includes selenium for glycemic markers, but only in adults who already have type 2 diabetes.
Pooled RCTs of 200 µg/day selenium vs placebo for new type 2 diabetes, alongside a separate analysis of observational studies.
Pooled selenium RCTs on fasting glucose and insulin, but only in patients with metabolic diseases.
Covers diabetic patients with glutathione and cardiometabolic outcomes, includes many supplements, and pools no data.
Antioxidants for diabetic kidney disease, with kidney outcomes rather than diabetes incidence or blood sugar.
Selenium RCTs on glucose outcomes, but in adults who already have type 2 diabetes (treatment, not prevention).
Pooled RCTs of selenium vs control for the risk of developing type 2 diabetes.

question.population: Adults in general or older adults (not a group defined by one illness, such as people in intensive care, on dialysis or with cancer)
question.intervention: Selenium supplements (alone, or with results for selenium apart)

decisions.reason: Mostly observational studies, but it reports a separate pooled RCT subgroup of selenium vs control for prostate cancer incidence.
Pools RCTs of selenium supplements vs placebo in adults for any cancer and site-specific cancer incidence.
Selenium vs placebo RCTs in adults for cancer, but the RCTs were summarised narratively rather than pooled.
Includes RCTs of selenium in healthy adults and pools them when two or more report a cancer outcome.
Pools RCTs of selenium alone vs placebo for cancer incidence.
Selenium and lung cancer with RCTs, but the abstract shows no pooled RCT estimate and mixes in observational and treatment evidence.
Pools antioxidant vs placebo RCTs for GI cancers, includes 9 selenium trials, and singles out selenium's effect.
Reports a separate pooled analysis of selenium vs placebo RCTs for prostate cancer incidence.
Antioxidant vs placebo RCT meta-analysis that reports separate selenium results for cancer incidence.
Antioxidant vs placebo RCT meta-analysis that reports a separate selenium estimate for colorectal cancer incidence.
Only cohort and case-control studies of selenium intake; no randomised trials of supplements.
Antioxidant vs placebo RCTs for GI cancers include selenium, but the abstract shows no separate selenium result.
Antioxidant vs placebo RCTs for GI cancers include selenium, but the abstract reports only pooled antioxidant effects.
Antioxidant vs placebo RCTs for GI cancers, with a separate result reported for selenium trials.
Selenium is among single-nutrient trials in adults, but the evidence is described as heterogeneous with no clear selenium-specific pooled result.
Selenium was given only in combination with other vitamins and minerals, with no separate selenium result.

question.population: Adults from the general population or at higher risk of heart disease
question.intervention: Selenium supplements (alone, or with results for selenium apart)
question.outcome: Heart and blood vessel disease, or death from any cause

decisions.reason: Selenium vs placebo in RCTs, but only in people with metabolic diseases and outcomes are blood risk markers, not heart disease or death.
Bibliometric study with a narrative summary; it does not pool randomised trials of selenium against placebo.
Review of experimental and lab studies on selenium and metabolic risk factors, with no pooled trials on heart disease or death.
Pools RCTs of selenium alone against control for heart and blood vessel disease and death from any cause.
Pools RCTs of selenium supplements and reports coronary heart disease death, plus blood markers.
Pools RCTs of many micronutrients and reports selenium on its own for heart and blood vessel disease outcomes.
Pools RCTs of selenium only vs placebo or nothing in general or high-risk adults, for heart disease and death from any cause.
Pools RCTs of oral selenium supplements and reports the effect on heart and blood vessel disease.
Pools RCTs of antioxidants vs placebo or nothing for death from any cause in healthy and ill adults, and looks at each antioxidant, including selenium, apart.
Outcomes are cancer cases and cancer deaths, not heart disease or death from any cause.
Pools antioxidant RCTs for death from any cause, but the abstract shows no selenium-only result and antioxidants were often given together.
Pools RCTs of antioxidants vs placebo for death from any cause and reports selenium apart.
Pools RCTs on coronary heart disease, but of supplements containing selenium, which may be combined with other nutrients.
Primary prevention of heart disease in general adults, but selenium is grouped with other single nutrients and no separate pooled result is shown.
